mechanism_narrative: A rise in GDP above its 6-month moving average indicates a strengthening economy, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of GDP growth above its 6-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 2% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4% indicates a tight labor market, leading to increased wage growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts above its 3-month moving average, combined with a rise in consumer spending, indicates a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of increasing housing starts and consumer spending (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below its 6-month moving average indicates a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4% signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to decreased borrowing and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high interest rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment above its 3-month moving average, combined with a decline in the unemployment rate, indicates a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of increasing payroll employment and low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in consumer price index below its 6-month moving average indicates decreased consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining consumer prices (t-test p > 0.05).
